PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":  (22.0, 14.0, 26.0),    # input pair (weak inversion, gm efficiency)
    "L1":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # input pair L (flicker noise area)
    "itail":  (8e-6, 5e-6, 10e-6),   # first-stage tail current
    "i7":     (18e-6, 12e-6, 20e-6), # output stage current
    "gmid7":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),     # PMOS mirror + output device (matched for offset)
    "L7":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmidm":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),     # NMOS ibias mirrors (tail, M8)
    "Lm":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidc":  (18.0, 12.0, 24.0),    # NMOS cascodes
    "gmidcb": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # stacked bias diode -> sets cascode gate voltage
    "fu":     (28e6, 24e6, 40e6),    # GBW target, sets Cc
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]; ih = it / 2

    # --- bias: Mb1 diode (nb) with Mb2 diode stacked on top -> ibias node = cascode gate
    mb1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidm"], p["Lm"], iref, vds=0.6)
    vnb = mb1.vgs
    mb2 = lut.size("n", p["gmidcb"], 0.5, iref, vds=0.6, vsb=vnb)
    vcn = vnb + mb2.vgs

    # --- input pair (estimate source node)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], ih, vds=0.3, vsb=0.3)
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], ih, vds=0.3, vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidm"], p["Lm"], it, vds=max(vtail, 0.15))

    # --- cascodes
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], 0.5, ih, vds=0.25, vsb=0.6)
    va = vcn - mc.vgs
    mc = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], 0.5, ih, vds=0.25, vsb=max(va, 0.0))
    va = vcn - mc.vgs

    # --- PMOS mirror load and output device (same L, gm/Id -> matched Vsg)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], ih, vds=0.9)
    vx1 = vdd - m3.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], ih, vds=m3.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidm"], p["Lm"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["fu"])

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb1", "nb", "nb", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("Mb2", "ibias", "ibias", "nb", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "nb", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "a1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "a2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M1C", "d1", "ibias", "a1", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M2C", "x1", "ibias", "a2", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "nb", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.C("CC", "vout", "a2", cc)            # indirect (Ahuja) compensation into cascode source

    # --- analytic predictions
    rcas = mc.gm / mc.gds / m1.gds
    gout1 = m3.gds + 1.0 / rcas
    a1 = gm1 / gout1
    a2v = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2v)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + mc.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * cc / (c1 * (cl + cc)) / (2 * PI)          # Ahuja nondominant pole
    p3 = mc.gm / (mc.cgg + m1.cdd) / (2 * PI)               # cascode-source node
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + mc.cdd) / (2 * PI)    # mirror pole (half doublet)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2) + math.atan(ugbw / p3)
                           + 0.5 * math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror))
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7)
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.6 / slew + 4.6 * tau * 1.5
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat
    ro5 = 1.0 / m5.gds
    cmrr_db = db(a1 * 2 * gm1 * ro5 * (m3.gm / gout1) ** 0.0) if False else db(2 * m3.gm * ro5 * a1 / (a1 + 1e-12) * gm1 / gout1 * 0.5)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    nth = math.sqrt(8 * kT * 0.8 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = nth * 6
    print(f"vnb={vnb:.3f} vcn={vcn:.3f} vtail={vtail:.3f} va={va:.3f} vx1={vx1:.3f} "
          f"Cc={cc*1e15:.0f}f C1={c1*1e15:.0f}f p2={p2/1e6:.1f}M p3={p3/1e6:.1f}M mir={pm_mirror/1e6:.1f}M")
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
